scope: full path-level semantic index reconstructed from the fixed tree and pinned avatar manifest
theme, size, format, delivery-policy, candidate-pool, and role-bindability tagging
structural rendition and exact Git-blob duplicate analysis
excluded: image binary download, copy, editing, derivation, or local SHA-256 recomputation
perceptual-image hashing or subjective visual similarity judgement
Visual Identity Binding, Visual Identity Release, alt text, page integration, publication, DSH, or runtime changes

source_integrity.g0_declared_canonicalization: Sort all selected tree blobs by path using en locale; concatenate path, TAB, git_blob_sha, TAB, bytes, LF for each row; hash the UTF-8 result.

replacement_canonicalization.canonicalization: Sort selected image blobs by Unicode code-point path order; concatenate path, TAB, git_blob_sha, TAB, bytes, LF; hash UTF-8.

separation_of_concerns.persona_family: Candidate-pool relation belongs to a source persona, not to each theme or size rendition.
separation_of_concerns.asset: Theme, size, format, path provenance, governance, and default delivery policy belong to an individual asset.
separation_of_concerns.semantic_relation: Same-persona rendition, theme-pair, size-variant, exact binary duplicate, and near-visual similarity are separate relation types.

near_visual_duplicate.reason: Requires an approved perceptual-hash method and visual review; structural rendition relations and exact frozen Git-blob equality must not be misreported as near-visual similarity.

known_gaps_and_next_gates.subject: VIS-G0 metadata fingerprint reproducibility
known_gaps_and_next_gates.detail: The frozen tree count and bytes match VIS-G0, but the documented en-locale reproduction attempt does not match the previously recorded image metadata fingerprint. The new VIS-G2 canonical fingerprint is recorded separately; do not replace the VIS-G0 value without a dedicated correction record.

known_gaps_and_next_gates.subject: Perceptual or near-visual duplicate review
known_gaps_and_next_gates.detail: Requires approved binary/perceptual-hash method and visual review. VIS-G2 completed structural rendition and exact frozen Git-blob analysis only.

known_gaps_and_next_gates.subject: Visual Identity Binding and Visual Identity Release
known_gaps_and_next_gates.detail: VIS-G3 owns the actual 50 AGT mappings and three MGT display bindings; VIS-G2 does not assign a primary image.
